prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: c027 (cap 31.36) is the strongest robust parent; a modest x0.7 tightening of the per-net weight cap to ~21.95 keeps the broad TNS benefit while slightly reducing the risk of the HBT-spacing/legalization failures seen when the cap was pushed too far, giving a safe confirmation/refinement.
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.826 robust(mean-std)=+0.230 min_case=+0.217 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.326 dWNS=+21.0% dTNS=+39.8% overflow~125
  bp-ng45: score=+0.217 dWNS=+18.6% dTNS=+23.9% overflow~132
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.283 dWNS=+15.2% dTNS=+36.9% overflow~131
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: all runs valid, robust mean-std +0.230, min_case +0.217, total +0.826. Every case improved, with bp-ng45 the weakest (dWNS +18.6%, dTNS +23.9%) and ariane133-ng45 strongest (dTNS +39.8%). The x0.7 cap tightening preserved broad TNS gains while avoiding the HBT-spacing/legalization failures, consistent with reduced per-net weight pressure. Next step: sweep cap between 21.95 and 31.36 (e.g., x0.8, x0.85) to locate the knee where TNS benefit saturates before legality risk reappears.
